body:
### Question

When running a uv script with the shebang `#!/usr/bin/env -S uv run --script`, the log message `Resolving dependencies` appears briefly every time.

Does this mean that dependencies are resolved from the internet on every execution?

Also, is the same true when running commands defined in `[project.scripts]` instead of using `--script`?

### Platform

Ubuntu 26.04, Linux 7.0.0-38-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.12.21 (7af826859 2026-09-29 x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)
title: Does a uv script access the Internet every time it runs?
